thread:
sam: Quick provenance + methodology check for the launch benchmark pack. Need a minimal, auditable artifact set we can attach to the blog and hand to legal.

sam: Concrete minimal asks:
- Warmup run: linear 5->150rps over 5m, hold 150rps for 10m (~9k reqs). Provide p50/p95/p99 and time-series CSV.
- Coldstart sweep: 3k single-shot requests across fresh replicas, heatmap + raw csv.
- Quant variants: fp16, q4_0, q5_1 (log OOMs, include fallback model if any).
- Long-tail: 8k token prompts (30 samples) both cold KV and warm KV.
- Sample provenance: a samples_manifest.json listing sample IDs, seed, md5 of payload file, and public path to original cohort (marketing_cohort_v5).
- Runbook: exact curl commands, infra (instance type, CUDA driver), kernel flags, and run ids.

nina: We care most about reproducibility: include seed and sample IDs, md5s for each artifact, and a SHA256 of the run metadata file. Also flag any runs marked EXPERIMENTAL.

kevin: Copy. Plan: schedule three jobs on pool-2 (job-warmup-20001, job-cold-20002, job-quant-20003). Artifacts uploaded to s3://internal-bench/marketing/1769005678/. We'll commit samples_manifest.json with seed=7 and list of 30 sample IDs for the long-tail.

kevin: Example manifest snippet we'll include (token redacted):

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-x-7b","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":2048,"stream":false}'
```

kevin: Outputs: warmup_timeseries.csv, cold_heatmap.png, quant_summary.csv (include peak GPU mem), long_tail_samples.csv, samples_manifest.json, runbook.txt, checksums.txt (md5 and sha256). We'll add a small warmup_blog.png for marketing.

sam: Embargo until launch week. Please mark any preliminary runs as PRELIMINARY in the manifest. Also include a plain-language claims_line in claims_audit.txt that maps p95 numbers to the sentence we want to use.

ops-bot: Jobs queued: job-warmup-20001, job-cold-20002, job-quant-20003 on pool-2. Logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/runs/20001. ETA ~24h.

kevin: I'll post S3 paths + MD5s here when uploads complete and tag @sam @nina. If any quant fails OOM or shows >15% perf regression vs fp16 we will call it out with fallback and link to fallback artifact.

sam: Thanks — that covers the legal checklist. Please be explicit about any sampling bias and include the raw sample file link in the manifest so auditors can rerun.

kevin: Will do. Posting updates here as jobs progress.
